title: Building a city-eating monster game with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Here's the ChibiType trailer
author: GanstonHamuel
selftext:
This is ChibiType, an action game where you play a biomass monster tearing through a city. You climb buildings, glide, and switch between five powers: Hammerfist, Claws, Blade, Whipfist and Tendrils.

Pretty much all of it came out of AI agents, mainly Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. That covers the code, the art, and even the edit on this trailer. My job has mostly been directing, testing, and telling them when something feels off.

The part that took the most back and forth was animation. Getting it to look right in a 2.5D world was really tough.

Still in development, no store page yet.

Curious how others split work between agents. Do you stick to one or bounce between them like I do?
